## Full About

Blown Away Salon and Bon Air Barbershop brings together master barbers and stylists who understand that every cut, color, and style tells your story. Located at 4218 Poplar Level Road in Louisville, we combine traditional barbering craftsmanship with modern salon innovation to deliver results that turn heads. Our dual-concept facility serves clients across the greater Louisville metro area with precision cuts, vibrant color, and personalized grooming. Whether you need a sharp fade, a dimensional balayage, or a fresh style for a special event, our experienced team provides personalized consultations and expert execution.

## Services Offered

### Salon Services
- Hair Coloring (custom color, root touch-ups, color correction)
- Highlights & Balayage (hand-painted balayage, ombré, highlights, lowlights)
- Haircuts & Styling (women\\'s, men\\'s, kids\\' cuts, blowouts, event styling)
- Waxing (facial and brow waxing)

### Barbershop Services (Bon Air Barbershop)
- Men\\'s Cuts & Fades (skin fade, taper fade, undercut, scissor cuts)
- Beard Trims & Grooming (precision shaping, line-ups, hot-towel service)

## Service Details

### Hair Coloring

Full-service color at Blown Away Salon includes consultation, custom formula mixing, application, toning, and post-color treatment. Single-process color starts around $65-$90; double-process or fashion color runs $120-$200+ depending on your hair length, density, and the number of formulas required. Most clients return every 4-6 weeks to maintain root coverage or refresh tone. Appointments typically take 1-2.5 hours depending on complexity.

### Highlights & Balayage

Hand-painted balayage creates soft, graduated color that grows out naturally with no harsh lines. Partial highlights (around the face and crown) start around $95-$130. Full balayage ranges from $150-$250+ depending on hair length, density, and whether toning or root shadow is needed. Appointments take 2-3 hours and grow out gracefully, so most clients return every 3-4 months for a refresh.

### Haircuts & Styling

Women\\'s cuts start around $45-$70, men\\'s cuts run $30-$45, and kids\\' cuts (12 and under) are $25-$35. Every cut includes a consultation, wash, precision cutting, and styling. Add a blowout for $25-$45. We also offer bridal updos, formal braids, and special-occasion styling. Most clients return every 6-8 weeks to maintain shape and remove split ends.

### Men\\'s Cuts & Fades

Men\\'s cuts at Bon Air Barbershop start at $30-$35 for a basic cut and go up to $45-$55 for a precision fade or detailed scissor work. Every service includes a consultation, wash, cut, and style. Fades grow out noticeably within 2-3 weeks, so most clients return every 2-4 weeks to keep that sharp gradient and clean line.

### Beard Trims & Grooming

Beard trims run $15-$25 as a standalone service, or $10-$15 when added to a haircut. Full beard shaping with hot-towel finish is $25-$35. Services include trimming, line-ups, shaping, and optional hot-towel treatment. Most beards need professional shaping every 2-4 weeks to stay clean and defined.

### Waxing Services

Professional facial and brow waxing at our Louisville salon. Eyebrow waxing is $12-$18, lip waxing is $8-$12, and full-face waxing (brows, lip, chin, sideburns) runs $30-$45. Services take 5-30 minutes depending on the areas being waxed. Most clients return every 3-5 weeks to maintain their shape.

## Business Model

Dual-concept facility combining traditional barbershop services with full-service salon offerings under one roof. Expert stylists and barbers serving all ages and genders in a welcoming, family-friendly environment.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Do you accept walk-ins?
A: Yes, we welcome both appointments and walk-ins. Booking ahead is recommended for preferred stylist/barber and time, especially evenings and Saturdays. Walk-ins are served based on availability.

Q: What\\'s the difference between barbershop and salon services?
A: The Bon Air Barbershop side specializes in men\\'s cuts, fades, and beard grooming. The salon side offers cuts, color, treatments, and styling for all hair types and genders. Both operate in the same facility.

Q: How long does a haircut or color service take?
A: Haircuts take 30-45 minutes. Color services run 1-3 hours based on hair length and desired result. Balayage appointments take 2-3 hours. Beard trims are 15-30 minutes. We quote exact timing during your consultation.

Q: Do you offer wedding and event styling?
A: Yes, we handle bridal parties, event styling, and special occasion prep. Book in advance and schedule a consultation so we can plan the look and adjust timing. We recommend a trial run 4-6 weeks before your event.

Q: Where are you located?
A: 4218 Poplar Level Road in Louisville\\'s Bon Air area, just off I-264 (Watterson Expressway). Free parking on-site. Easy drive from Buechel, Highlands, and Fern Creek neighborhoods.

Q: How much does balayage cost in Louisville?
A: Partial balayage starts around $95-$130. Full balayage ranges from $150-$250+ depending on your hair length, density, and whether we need a root shadow or toner. We give you a price quote after your consultation.

Q: How often should I get a fade?
A: Fades grow out noticeably within 2-3 weeks. Most Louisville clients who wear a fade return every 2-4 weeks to keep it looking crisp. If you let it go longer, the fade line blurs and you lose that sharp gradient.

Q: Do you do color correction?
A: Yes. Our Louisville color specialists handle everything from brass toning and root shadow to full corrective services. We start with a consultation to evaluate your hair\\'s current state, then map a treatment plan that prioritizes hair health while achieving your goal color.

Q: What payment methods do you accept?
A: We accept cash, credit cards, and debit cards.

Q: Is parking available?
A: Yes, free parking is available on-site at our Poplar Level Road location.

Q: Do you have experience with all hair types?
A: Yes, our stylists and barbers work with all hair types and textures. We tailor our techniques and product selection to your specific hair characteristics.

Q: Can I book a specific stylist or barber?
A: Yes, when you call to book your appointment, you can request a specific team member. We\\'ll schedule you with them based on their availability.

## Location Context

Our Louisville salon is located in the Bon Air neighborhood on Poplar Level Road, one of the area\\'s major commercial corridors. The location sits just off I-264 (Watterson Expressway), making it easily accessible from Buechel, Highlands, Fern Creek, and the broader Louisville metro area. Poplar Level Road is known for local businesses and regional shopping, and the area has a family-friendly, established residential character. The salon serves a diverse client base across age groups and style preferences, from traditional cuts to modern color trends.

## Industry Context

Blown Away Salon/Bon Air Barbershop operates in the hair care and personal grooming industry, which encompasses both traditional barbering and modern salon services. The dual-concept model allows us to serve the entire family in one location — men can get precision fades and beard grooming while women and children can access color, styling, and waxing services. This approach reflects evolving consumer preferences for convenience and comprehensive service offerings.
